datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data were collected for different IPC scenarios and compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML) with classification scales, collection dates, and food security phase assignments for administrative units in Cameroon during 2022.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys documenting acute food insecurity classifications across geographic units in Cameroon.
